appearance.extreme: Their flesh crawls constantly, closing and reforming. Something opened them earlier today and there's no mark left to say where.
appearance.obvious: A fresh wound on their forearm is knitting shut as you look at it, pink and working.
appearance.subtle: A cut on their hand is already closing.

description: Your body has stopped accepting damage as permanent. Wounds close while you watch, and the process isn't pleasant to be inside.
drawbacks: Healing hurts more than the wound
name: Regenerative Flesh
